funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage in their career; applicant must be author or editor of the proposed publication; must have a publisher confirmed and publication date scheduled within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering practical publishing costs such as image copyright fees.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed; organisations can apply for one Research Project Grant per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in the field of British art, visual culture and architectural history, including public-facing outcomes and/or legacy (e.g. exhibitions, digital projects, catalogues).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; the exhibition from which the publication is based can be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, covering practical elements of publishing costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis; items must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to protect and preserve significant works of British art by undertaking original and needed conservation research, covering staff costs and equipment.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel costs and equipment.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Opportunity: Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); applications from prospective members with pending membership accepted.
opportunities.summary: Micro-grant to support ERBA members' research trips to libraries, archives, collections or sites, or to meet key contacts or attend events directly related to their research, covering transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage of career for amounts up to £8,000; amounts £8,001-£20,000 available to postdoctoral-level individuals or with equivalent research experience. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research in British art, supporting research time (including staff backfill) and/or research travel to view collections or visit archives, plus some additional costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's-level or doctoral degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's-level or doctoral degree in British art who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country; funded from the Andrew Wyld Fund.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for registered students to undertake research trips to examine historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if part-time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in the field of British art that brings new perspectives to understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028; international applicants may apply but amount is fixed at £32,000/year.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support doctoral research in British art, paying university fees with the remainder for living expenses, plus an extra £500 per year for networking/mentorship activities.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: one year at £35,000, or two years at £70,000 (paid £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake a major in-depth research project in the field of British art that reshapes understanding of British art, taken over one or two years.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, as well as an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy, who would benefit from an extended stay in Rome.
